1. (Currently Amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __that does not chemically disrupt the embryo axis or scutellum__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material __by a method other than cell wall disruption using enzymes or sonication__; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos __after step (c)__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __and the agitation step is performed for a duration of less than 1 hour__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation __wherein the cold temperature is below 0°C and the heat temperature is above 65°C__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __at least three times consecutively__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material to a temperature above 95°C and agitation __performed simultaneously__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __at least three times consecutively__.

7. (Cancelled)

8. (Cancelled)

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __using a non-enzymatic extraction method__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __and applying a magnetic field to separate the DNA from cellular debris__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos __that are less than 14 days post-pollination__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d) __in a quiescent state at a temperature below 4°C for at least 7 days__.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed on DNA obtained without prior whole genome amplification__.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads __and wherein the genotyping is performed directly on the DNA extracted from the shed cellular material without intermediate purification steps__.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __wherein the phenotyping is performed on plants derived from embryos that were previously subjected to the molecular analysis of step (c)__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __using isothermal amplification methods__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __wherein the selection is made before step (d) and based on genotype data indicating a desired trait__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __within 30 days of the genotyping analysis__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __using a robotic system that performs embryo handling, DNA extraction, and genotyping analysis__.
